quick_english: It should be thirty-six fingers in length and eight fingers in width.

tokens.grounds: Compound describing dimensions: ṣaṭtriṃśat-aṅgula-āyāma (length of thirty-six fingers) and aṣṭa-aṅgula-su-vistara (width of eight fingers).

quick_english: In its width and length, it should resemble the face of a boar.

tokens.grounds: Compound/phrase: vistāreṇa ca dairghyeṇa (in width and length) sūkara-ānana-sannibham (resembling a boar's face).

quick_english: The ear should be two measures in length and four fingers in width.

tokens.grounds: Specifies ear dimensions: karṇa-dairghyam (ear length) dvi-mātram (two measures) syāt (should be), vistāram (width) catur-aṅgulam (four fingers).

quick_english: It may be three or four measures, and a hole is prescribed in its middle.

tokens.grounds: Alternative measures and feature: tri-mātram vā catur-mātram (three or four measures), tan-madhye (in its middle), bilam ucyate (a hole is called/prescribed).

quick_english: It should be made four fingers, increasing by a quarter finger at a time.

tokens.grounds: Instruction on increment: ardha-ardha-aṅgula-vṛddhyā (by increase of a quarter finger), tu (but/indeed), kartavyam (to be made), catur-aṅgulam (four fingers).

quick_english: The sruk should be made, and the sruva likewise should have its measure derived from the same source.

tokens.grounds: Relates sruk and sruva: sruk syāt (there should be a sruk), sruve api (also in the sruva), tad-yoniḥ (its source/origin), tan-mānam (that measure), tatas tataḥ bhavet (should be from that).

quick_english: The circumference should be six fingers at the base of the handle and at the lotus.

tokens.grounds: Specifies handle dimensions: ṣaḍ-aṅgula-parīṇāhaḥ (six-finger circumference), daṇḍa-mūle (at the base of the handle), ca puṣkare (and at the lotus/bowl).

quick_english: The place for ghee at its tip should be made in the shape of a tower.

tokens.grounds: Describes the ghee receptacle: gopura-ākāra-vat (like a tower/gateway), kāryam (to be made), ājya-sthānam (place for ghee), tad-agrake (at its tip).

quick_english: A new implement is best; an old one may be used only if a new one is not available.

tokens.grounds: Preference rule: nūtanam karaṇam śreṣṭham (a new implement is best), purāṇam tad-abhāvataḥ (an old one in its absence).

quick_english: It should be used only after prior authorization, and then it may serve as the implement for enjoyment.

tokens.grounds: Condition for use: tad-ājñā-pūrvakam (preceded by that command/authorization), sa syāt (it should be), tad-bhogya-karaṇam (that implement for use/enjoyment), tataḥ (then).

quick_english: The rite follows the scripture and the place according to which it was previously conducted.

tokens.grounds: Establishes precedent: yena śāstreṇa (by which scripture), yat-sthāne (in which place), kriyā pūrvam pravartate (the rite previously proceeds/is conducted).

quick_english: Whatever is not stated should be taken from elsewhere in festivals and other rites.

tokens.grounds: Rule for gaps: anuktam (what is unstated), anyataḥ grāhyam (to be taken from elsewhere), utsava-ādiṣu karmasu (in festivals and other rites).

quick_english: Even if it is excellent and accomplished in its own place, an object situated in another shrine should not be taken.

tokens.grounds: Restriction on borrowing: śreṣṭhaḥ tad-dhāma-saṃsiddhaḥ (best, accomplished in that place), na grāhyaḥ anya-ālaya-sthitaḥ (not to be taken if situated in another shrine).

quick_english: If an established image or the like is favorable and compatible with that deity's sign and other features, it may be considered.

tokens.grounds: Conditional case: tat-liṅga-ādi-anukūlam cet (if favorable to that sign/emblem etc.), bera-ādyam yat pratiṣṭhitam (whatever image etc. is established).

quick_english: One should perform rites to purify the defect arising from transferring it from one place to another.

tokens.grounds: Prescribes remedy: sthānāt sthāna-antara-prāpti-doṣa-śuddhi-artham (for purification of the defect of transfer from one place to another), ācaret (one should perform).

quick_english: It should be accompanied by abundant worship using the short prāsāda mantra.

tokens.grounds: Specifies the rite: hrasva-prāsāda-mantreṇa (with the short prāsāda mantra), prabhūta-yajana-anvitam (accompanied by abundant worship).

quick_english: The height of the kanyasa structures should be five, six, or seven cubits.

tokens.grounds: Specifies height range: pañca-ṣaṭ-sapta-hastāni (five, six, or seven cubits), kanyasānām (of the maidens/smaller structures), samucchrayaḥ (height).

quick_english: Among these, an increase beyond the cubit is recognized, marked as appropriate for its own proportional growth.

tokens.grounds: Further specification: teṣu (among them), hastāt paraḥ (beyond a cubit), khyātaḥ (known), sva-vṛddhi-arha-upalakṣitaḥ (marked as fit for its own increase).

quick_english: Alternatively, for others it may be three or eight fingers, or sixteen fingers.

tokens.grounds: Alternative measures: śalya-vasu-aṅgulān vā atha (three or eight fingers, or else), pareṣām (of others), ṣoḍaśa-aṅgulam (sixteen fingers). Uses numerical synonyms śalya (3) and vasu (8).

quick_english: Or it may be half the measure of the rise, as is prescribed at the beginning.

tokens.grounds: Another alternative: udaya-ardha-pramāṇam vā (or half the measure of the rise), yādau ādau paripaṭhyate (as is recited at the beginning/such as first stated).

quick_english: The rite for well-being is to be performed properly; listen, O twice-born ones.

tokens.grounds: Introductory injunction: saukhya-karma prakartavyam (the rite for well-being is to be performed), yathāvat śṛṇuta dvijāḥ (listen properly, O twice-born ones).

quick_english: Rudra created the celestial nymphs for the sake of Kauśika's pleasure.

tokens.grounds: Mythic account: sasarja apsarasaḥ (created the apsaras), rudraḥ (Rudra), kauśika-prīti-kāraṇāt (for the sake of Kauśika's pleasure).

quick_english: An eternal state arose, untouchable by those of reverse birth and others.

tokens.grounds: States a condition: aspṛśyam (untouchable), pratiloma-ādyaiḥ (by those of reverse order and others), ajāyata (was born/arose), sanātanam (eternal).

quick_english: Formerly, in the deity's grove, I did this for the sake of amusement.

tokens.grounds: Locates a past event: devatā-aru-vane (in the grove of the deity), pūrvam (before), vinoda-artham (for the sake of amusement), mayā purā (by me formerly).

quick_english: The sage-wives who were there saw me and, though respectful, could not contain themselves.

tokens.grounds: Fused sequence: tatra-sthāḥ (staying there) + muni-patnyaḥ (sages' wives) + mām (me) + dṛṣṭvā (having seen) + sa-ādaram-akṣamāḥ (with respect, unable to endure); sandhi and compounding preserved as given.
